name: workbook-triggers
description: At the end of a turn with cheap signs of recordable work (code edits with no workbook edit, a run of failures on one error, half an hour of work), asks a fork of the session whether an update trigger of RULES.md section 2 fired, and if so has the agent write the entry before it stops.

minCodeEdits.title: Code edits before a check
minCodeEdits.description: Edits of code files (not Markdown, not the workbook) since the last workbook edit that make the end of a turn ask the fork. 0 turns this signal off.

failureRun.title: Failures on one error
failureRun.description: Failed shell runs with the same error since the last workbook edit that make the end of a turn ask the fork. 0 turns this signal off.

workMinutes.title: Minutes of work
workMinutes.description: Minutes of model turns since the last workbook edit that make the end of a turn ask the fork. 0 turns this signal off.
